description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid model, and candidates in this role can be based remotely. You may be expected to travel to meet in person during your team’s scheduled collaboration weeks. Managers will determine in-person time according to business needs.

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to own the operational backbone of campaign execution on our B2B Revenue Operations team. You’ll administer and optimize our marketing automation and CRM platforms, architect scalable campaign workflows, and safeguard data integrity across the funnel.

You’ll be the platform expert that Demand Gen, Sales, Lifecycle, and ABM teams turn to, translating requests into clean, well-governed builds — while leading enablement efforts that raise platform fluency across the broader marketing org. This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to lead through expertise and influence, while be a key owner and deep in the weeds of campaign building.

Superhuman’s go-to-market teams are shaping the future of workplace communication. As a member of our team, you will be crucial in expanding the use of our innovative, trustworthy AI writing tools. We strive to ensure that every organization can communicate effectively and efficiently. If you are passionate about transforming the way professionals connect and collaborate, we would love to hear from you.

In this role, you will own:

Campaign Operations

  • Own end-to-end build and QA of multi-channel campaigns (email, forms, landing pages, nurture, ABM) across our marketing automation platform and Salesforce, ensuring accurate segmentation, targeting, and send logic.

  • Lead collaboration across project teams with multiple stakeholders — Demand Gen, Lifecycle, ABM, and Sales Ops — translating campaign strategy into operationally sound, scalable execution plans.

  • Build and operate account-based marketing campaigns within our ABM stack (e.g., Folloze, Mutiny, Reachdesk, 6sense) — orchestrating personalized microsites, intent signals, and multi-channel touches into coordinated plays for target accounts, and ensuring engagement data flows cleanly back into Salesforce and our reporting.

  • Push beyond content and asset automation to automate the operational mechanics of campaign builds themselves — using AI-assisted or agentic tooling (including MCP-based workflows) to construct and manage martech objects like Salesforce/Pardot campaigns or workflows, audience logic, and program setup.

Platform Administration

  • Hold oversight and accountability for our marketing automation and CRM platforms — administering configuration, integrations, and the ongoing performance of the applications you own.

  • Monitor and maintain data integrity across Pardot, Salesforce, and all platform integrations, including sync errors, deduplication, field standardization, and lead routing.

  • Contribute to our operational and tech strategy alongside your manager, aligning operational requirements with Managed Business stakeholder needs at the line-of-business level.

Stakeholder Enablement

  • Lead stakeholder enablement — building SOPs, training materials, and platform documentation that raise self-serve fluency across the marketing org.

  • Set the bar for operational rigor and campaign governance, modeling initiative and ownership that raises the standard for peers.

Data, Insights & Process

  • Proactively surface anomalies in funnel health, campaign performance, or data flow, partnering with Data/Analytics to diagnose and resolve.

  • Interpret campaign data and translate it into clear recommendations, not just reporting — e.g., diagnosing why an email campaign underperformed and advising the team on what to change (or stop doing) next time.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of B2B marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation experience, preferably in SaaS.

  • Deep, hands-on administrator-level expertise in a marketing automation platform (Pardot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, HubSpot, etc.) — building programs, workflows, forms, templates, and segmentation from the ground up, with proven ownership of platform performance and health.

  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CRM (campaigns/campaign members, leads vs. contacts, reports/list views) and experience with data tools like Hightouch.

  • Hands-on experience with ABM platforms (e.g., Folloze, Mutiny, Reachdesk, 6sense) — building and operating account-based campaigns, orchestrating intent/engagement data into workflows, and integrating these tools with our core martech stack.

  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering platform training or enablement programs for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of lead lifecycle, funnel metrics, attribution, and campaign reporting, with the analytical rigor to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Proven ability to lead collaboration across multi-stakeholder project teams and influence without direct authority — setting the bar for execution quality and modeling ownership for peers.

  • A strong plus: you’ve applied AI or agentic tooling to automate the operational mechanics of campaign builds — constructing or managing Salesforce/Pardot campaign objects, Marketo programs, or similar martech constructs — with demonstrated rigor in how that automation was designed, tested, and governed.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments

Compensation and Benefits

Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:

  • Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)

  • Disability and life insurance options

  • 401(k) and RRSP matching

  • Paid parental leave

  • 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time

  • Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more)

  • Annual professional development budget and opportunities

Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations.

For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).
